units.literal: The Emperor also secretly drafted a list of matters and was about to remonstrate; his friend Wang Xi thought it inadvisable.

units.zh: 先是禁友王晞，乃捨之，令侍帝。
units.en: Wang Xi, his friend, had earlier been placed under restriction; now Emperor Wenxuan freed him and set him to wait on the prince.
units.literal: Earlier Wang Xi, his friend, had been confined; now he released him and ordered him to attend the Emperor.

units.zh: 同軌病卒，又命開府長流參軍刁柔代之，性嚴褊，不適誘訓之宜，中被遣出。
units.en: After Tonggui died of illness, Diao Rou, a senior staff officer in the chief's office, was appointed in his place—but Diao was harsh and rigid, ill suited to teaching, and before long was dismissed.
units.literal: When Tonggui died of illness, he again ordered Diao Rou, Staff Supervisor of the Chief's Office, to replace him; Diao's nature was stern and narrow, unsuited to guidance and instruction, and midway through he was dismissed and sent away.

units.zh: 遂篤志讀《漢書》，至《李陵傳》，恒壯其所為焉。
units.en: He then applied himself to the Book of Han; when he came to the biography of Li Ling, he always took fierce pride in Li Ling's conduct.
units.literal: Thereupon he devoted himself to reading the Book of Han, and when he reached the "Biography of Li Ling," he always admired what Li Ling had done.

units.zh: 七年，從文宣還鄴。
units.en: In the seventh year he returned to Ye with Emperor Wenxuan.
units.literal: In the seventh year, he followed Wenxuan back to Ye.

units.zh: 乾明元年，從廢帝赴鄴，居於領軍府。
units.en: In Qianming 1 he accompanied Emperor Fei to Ye and resided at the headquarters of the Commanding General.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianming, he followed Emperor Fei to Ye and lived at the headquarters of the Commanding General.

units.zh: 三月甲戌，帝初上省，旦發領軍府，大風暴起，壞所御車幔，帝甚惡之。
units.en: On the jiaxu day of the third month, the prince went to the Secretariat for the first time. At dawn he left the Commander-in-Chief's headquarters; a sudden gale tore the curtains of his carriage, and he took it as a dire omen.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day of the third month, the Emperor for the first time went to the Secretariat; at dawn he set out from the Commander-in-Chief's office; a violent windstorm arose and destroyed the curtains of his carriage—the Emperor regarded it as highly ominous.

units.zh: 二年春正月辛亥，祀圓丘。
units.en: On the xinhai day of the first month of the second year, he sacrificed at the Altar of Heaven.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of year 2, on the xinhai day, he sacrificed at the Round Altar.

units.zh: 十一月甲辰，詔曰：「朕嬰此暴疾，奄忽無逮。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, an edict declared, "I have been struck by a sudden grave illness and can no longer attend to affairs.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, an edict said: "I have been stricken by this violent illness and suddenly can no longer reach affairs.

units.zh: 是月，帝親戎北討庫莫奚，出長城，虜奔遁，分兵致討，大獲牛馬，括總入晉陽宮。
units.en: That month the emperor personally led a campaign north against the Kumo Xi. He passed beyond the Great Wall; the enemy fled in rout; he sent columns in pursuit and captured large herds of cattle and horses, which were tallied and brought into Jinyang Palace.
units.literal: That month, the emperor personally took the field and marched north to attack the Kumo Xi; he passed beyond the Great Wall, the enemy fled in rout, he sent troops in separate columns to pursue them, captured large numbers of cattle and horses, and tallied the whole and brought it into Jinyang Palace.

units.zh: 坐定，酒數行，執尚書令楊愔、右僕射燕子獻、領軍可朱渾天和、侍中宋欽道等於坐。
units.en: They had barely settled in and taken a few cups when he seized Chief Minister Yang Yin, Right Vice Director Yanzi Xian, Commander-in-Chief Kezhuhun Tianhe, Palace Attendant Song Qindao, and the rest where they sat.
units.literal: Once seated, after a few rounds of wine, he seized Chief Minister Yang Yin, Right Deputy Director Yanzi Xian, Commander-in-Chief Kezhuhun Tianhe, Palace Attendant Song Qindao, and others at the banquet.

units.zh: 帝戎服與平原王段韶、平秦王高歸彥、領軍劉洪徽入自雲龍門，於中書省前遇散騎常侍鄭子默，又執之，同斬於御府之內。
units.en: In armor, with Prince Duan Shao of Pingyuan, Prince Gao Guiyan of Pingqin, and Commander-in-Chief Liu Honghui, he entered through the Cloud Dragon Gate. Before the Secretariat he met Regular Attendant Zheng Zimo, seized him too, and had them all beheaded inside the Imperial Treasury.
units.literal: The Emperor, in military garb, together with Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, Prince of Pingqin Gao Guiyan, and Commander-in-Chief Liu Honghui, entered through the Cloud Dragon Gate; before the Secretariat they encountered Regular Attendant Zheng Zimo, seized him as well, and beheaded them all together inside the Imperial Treasury.

units.zh: 帝常恐濟南復興，乃密行鳩毒，濟南不從，乃扼而殺之。
units.en: The emperor, fearing that the Prince of Jinan might regain power, secretly sent poison; when the prince refused to take it, he was strangled to death.
units.literal: The Emperor often feared the Prince of Jinan would rise again, and so secretly administered poison; when the Prince of Jinan refused, he strangled him to death.

units.zh: 有兔驚馬，帝墜而絕肋。
units.en: A rabbit startled his horse, and the emperor fell, breaking his ribs.
units.literal: A rabbit startled the horse; the Emperor fell and broke his ribs.

units.zh: 每歎云：「雖盟津之師，左驂震而不衄。」
units.en: He often sighed and said, "Even when the army stood at Mengjin and the left outer horse shied, they did not break and flee."
units.literal: He would often sigh and say: "Even at the army at Mengjin, though the left outer horse was startled, they did not retreat in defeat."

units.zh: 帝笑曰：「誠如卿言。
units.en: The emperor smiled and said, "You are quite right.
units.literal: The Emperor smiled and said: "It is truly as you say.

units.zh: 朕初臨萬機，慮不周悉，故致爾耳。
units.en: When I first assumed the throne, I had not yet grasped every detail of governance, and that is why this happened.
units.literal: When I first took charge of the myriad affairs of state, my concerns were not thorough and complete; that is why this came about.

units.zh: 此事安可久行，恐後又嫌疏漏。」
units.en: This cannot go on indefinitely—I am afraid you will later find me negligent again."
units.literal: How can this matter be carried on for long? I fear that afterward you will again find omissions.

units.zh: 趙郡王叡與厙狄顯安侍坐，帝曰：「須拔我同堂弟，顯安我親姑子，今序家人禮，除君臣之敬，可言我之不逮。」
units.en: Prince of Zhao Gao Rui and Kudi Xian'an were seated in attendance. The emperor said, "Xu Ba is my cousin; Xian'an is my aunt's son. Today we observe family etiquette and put aside the formalities of ruler and subject—you may tell me where I fall short."
units.literal: Prince of Zhao Rui and Kudi Xian'an were in attendance seated beside him. The Emperor said: "Xu Ba is my paternal cousin; Xian'an is the son of my paternal aunt. Today let us observe family rites and set aside the respect due between ruler and minister—you may speak of where I fall short.

units.zh: 甲午，詔曰：「昔武王克殷，先封兩代，漢、魏、二晉，無廢茲典。
units.en: On the jiawu day, an edict stated: "When King Wu of Zhou conquered the Shang, he first enfeoffed descendants of the two preceding dynasties. The Han, Wei, and two Jin dynasties likewise never abandoned this precedent.
units.literal: On the jiawu day, an edict said: "In antiquity, when King Wu conquered Yin, he first enfeoffed the two former dynasties; Han, Wei, and the two Jin dynasties did not abandon this precedent.

units.zh: 及元氏統歷，不率舊章。
units.en: But when the Northern Wei held power, they ceased to follow the old rites.
units.literal: When the Yuan clan held the succession, they did not follow the old statutes.

units.zh: 朕纂承大業，思弘古典，但二王三恪，舊說不同，可議定是非，列名條奏。
units.en: We have inherited the imperial enterprise and wish to restore the ancient practice, but scholars disagree on the rites for enfeoffing descendants of prior dynasties; let the matter be debated, the correct view determined, and the names submitted in memorial.
units.literal: We have inherited the great enterprise and wish to restore the ancient model, but the old accounts differ on the two kings and three classes of former dynasties; the right and wrong should be debated and determined, and the names listed in a memorial.

units.zh: 其禮義體式亦仰議之。」
units.en: The ritual forms and ceremonial standards should likewise be submitted for deliberation."
units.literal: The ritual forms and ceremonial standards should also be submitted for deliberation."

units.zh: 今嗣子沖眇，未閑政術，社稷業重，理歸上德。
units.en: The heir is young and slight, not yet versed in statecraft. The charge of the dynasty is heavy, and by rights it should pass to one of highest virtue.
units.literal: Now the heir is young and slight, not yet practiced in the arts of government; the work of the altars of soil and grain is weighty, and by principle it returns to one of highest virtue.

units.zh: 其喪紀之禮一同漢文，三十六日悉從公除，山陵施用，務從儉約。」
units.en: As for mourning rites, follow entirely the precedent of Emperor Wen of Han. After thirty-six days all mourning shall be removed according to public rule, and the mausoleum expenses must be kept frugal."
units.literal: As for the rites of mourning, let all be the same as under Emperor Wen of Han; after thirty-six days, all shall follow public removal of mourning, and the expenditures for the mountain mausoleum must follow frugality."

units.zh: 遣使詔追長廣王入纂大統，手書云：「宜將吾妻子置一好處，勿學前人也。」
units.en: He dispatched envoys with an edict summoning the Prince of Changguang to succeed him, writing in his own hand: "See that my wife and children are placed somewhere safe; do not do as those before you did."
units.literal: He sent envoys with an edict summoning the Prince of Changguang to succeed to the great succession, writing in his own hand: "You should place my wife and children in a good place; do not imitate those before you."

units.zh: 初苦內熱，頻進湯散。
units.en: At first he was troubled by internal fever and took medicinal broths and powders repeatedly.
units.literal: At first he suffered from internal heat and frequently took decoctions and powders.

units.zh: 遂漸危篤。
units.en: His illness thereupon grew steadily worse.
units.literal: Thereupon his condition gradually became critical.

units.zh: 帝時以尊親而見猜斥，乃與長廣王期獵，謀之於野。
units.en: Because his rank and kinship made him suspect, Xiaozhao was being pushed aside. He therefore arranged a hunt with Prince Zhan of Changguang and plotted with him in the field.
units.literal: The emperor at that time, because he was an honored kinsman, was regarded with suspicion and pushed aside; he therefore arranged to hunt with the Prince of Changguang and plotted with him in the countryside.

units.zh: 孝昭早居臺閤，故事通明，人吏之間，無所不委。
units.en: Emperor Xiaozhao had long served in the imperial secretariat, knew its precedents inside out, and was entrusted with every matter great and small.
units.literal: Xiaozhao early occupied the Terrace Pavilion; he was thoroughly versed in precedent; between men and officials nothing was not entrusted to him.

units.zh: 乙巳，太師、常山王演矯詔誅尚書令楊愔、尚書右僕射燕子獻、領軍大將軍可朱渾天和、侍中宋欽道、散騎常侍鄭子默。
units.en: On the yisi day Prince Yan of Changshan, grand preceptor, forged an edict and had executed Yang Yin, director of the Masters of Writing; Yanzi Xian, right vice-director; Kezhuhun Tianhe, commanding general of the palace guards; Song Qindao, palace attendant; and Zheng Zimo, attendant of the scattered cavalry.
units.literal: On the yisi day the grand preceptor, Prince of Changshan Yan, forged an edict and executed Yang Yin, director of the Masters of Writing; Yanzi Xian, right vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Kezhuhun Tianhe, general-in-chief commanding the guards; Song Qindao, attendant at the palace; and Zheng Zimo, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry.

units.zh: 及帝將建中宮，高隆之、高德正言漢婦人不可為天下母，宜更擇美配。
units.en: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.
units.literal: When the emperor was about to establish the central palace, Gao Longzhi and Gao Dezheng said a Han woman could not be mother to the realm and that a more beautiful match should be chosen.

units.zh: 屬周武遭太后喪，詔侍中薛孤、康買等為弔使，又遣商胡齎錦彩三萬疋與使同往，欲市真珠為皇后造七寶車，周人不與交易，然而竟造焉。
units.en: When Emperor Wu of Zhou was in mourning for his mother, envoys Xue Gu and Kang Mai were sent as condolence missions; merchant envoys carried thirty thousand bolts of brocade to buy pearls for a seven-treasure carriage for the empress—the Zhou people refused to trade, yet the carriage was built anyway.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu of Zhou was mourning his mother, envoys Xue Gu and Kang Mai were sent as condolence missions; merchant envoys carried thirty thousand bolts of brocade to buy pearls for a seven-treasure carriage for the empress—the Zhou people refused trade, yet the carriage was built anyway.

units.zh: 乙卯，以司徒、平秦王歸彥為太傅，以尚書右僕射、趙郡王叡為尚書令，以太尉尉粲為太保，以尚書令段韶為大司馬，以豐州刺史婁叡為司空，乙太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以太保、彭城王浟為太師、錄尚書事，以冀州刺史、博陵王濟為太尉，以中書監、任城王潛為尚書左僕射，以幷州刺史斛律光為右僕射，封孝昭皇帝太子百年為樂陵郡王。
units.en: On the yimao day, the emperor reshuffled the highest offices: Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, Minister over the Masses, became Grand Tutor; Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, became Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Grand Commandant Wei Can became Grand Guardian; Duan Shao became Grand Marshal; Lou Rui became Minister of Works; Prince Yan of Pingyang became Grand Minister; Prince You of Pengcheng became Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat; Prince Ji of Boling became Grand Commandant; Prince Qian of Rencheng became Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Hulu Guang became Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; and Emperor Xiaozhao's crown prince Bainian was made Prince of Leling Commandery.
units.literal: On the yimao day, Minister over the Masses and Prince Guiyan of Pingqin was made Grand Tutor; Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Grand Commandant Wei Can was made Grand Guardian; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Duan Shao was made Grand Marshal; Inspector of Feng Province Lou Rui was made Minister of Works; Grand Tutor and Prince Yan of Pingyang was made Grand Minister; Grand Guardian and Prince You of Pengcheng was made Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat; Inspector of Ji Province and Prince Ji of Boling was made Grand Commandant; Director of the Secretariat and Prince Qian of Rencheng was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Inspector of Bing Province Hulu Guang was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; and Emperor Xiaozhao's crown prince Bainian was enfeoffed as Prince of Leling Commandery.

units.zh: 己丑，以尚書右僕射斛律光為尚書令。
units.en: On the jichou day, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the jichou day, Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 丁酉，以大司馬段韶為太傅，以司空婁叡為司徒，乙太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以尚書令斛律光為司空，以太子太傅、趙郡王叡為尚書令，中書監、河間王孝琬為尚書左僕射。
units.en: On the dingyou day, Grand Marshal Duan Shao was made Grand Tutor; Minister of Works Lou Rui was made Minister over the Masses; Grand Tutor and Prince Yan of Pingyang was appointed Grand Preceptor; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works; Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince and Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; and Director of the Secretariat and Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the dingyou day, Grand Marshal Duan Shao was appointed Grand Tutor; Minister of Works Lou Rui was made Minister over the Masses; Grand Tutor and Prince of Pingyang Yan was appointed Grand Preceptor; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works; Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince and Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; and Director of the Secretariat and Prince of Hejian Xiaowan was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 三月乙丑，詔司空斛律光督五營軍士築戍於軹關。
units.en: In the third month, on the yichou day, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hulu Guang to supervise soldiers of the Five Garrisons in building a fortress at Zhiguan.
units.literal: In the third month, on the yichou day, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hulu Guang to supervise soldiers of the Five Garrisons in building a fortress at Zhiguan.

units.zh: 庚辰，以司空斛律光為司徒，以侍中、武興王普為尚書左僕射。
units.en: On the gengchen day, Minister of Works Hulu Guang was appointed Minister over the Masses, and Palace Attendant Prince Pu of Wuxing was appointed left vice-director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: On the gengchen day, Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister over the Masses, and Palace Attendant Prince Pu of Wuxing was made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 己巳，乙太師段韶為太宰，以司徒斛律光為太尉，幷州刺史蘭陵王長恭為尚書令。
units.en: On jisi, Duan Shao was made Grand Minister, Hulu Guang was made Grand Commandant, and Prince Changgong of Lanling, Inspector of Bing Province, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the jisi day, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao was made Grand Minister, Minister over the Masses Hulu Guang was made Grand Commandant, and Prince Changgong of Lanling, Inspector of Bing Province, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 魏左僕射楊昱、西阿王元慶、撫軍將軍元顯恭率御仗羽林宗子庶子衆凡七萬，據滎陽拒顥。
units.en: Left Vice Director Yang Yu, Prince Qing of Xi'a, and Pacification Army General Yuan Xiangong led seventy thousand imperial guards and cadets to hold Yingyang against Hao.
units.literal: Yang Yu, Left Vice Director under Wei, Prince Qing of Xi'a, Yuan Qing, and Pacification Army General Yuan Xiangong led the imperial guard Forest Guard cadets and sons of the clans, in all seventy thousand, and held Yingyang to resist Hao.

units.zh: 魏將元天穆大軍復將至，先遣其驃騎將軍尒朱吐沒兒領胡騎五千，騎將魯安領夏州步騎九千，援楊昱；
units.en: Yuan Tianmu's main army was closing in. He first sent Cavalry General Erzhu Tumener with five thousand barbarian horse and Cavalry Commander Lu An with nine thousand mixed troops from Xia province to reinforce Yang Yu;
units.literal: The Wei general Yuan Tianmu's great army was again about to arrive; he first sent his Cavalry General Erzhu Tumener with five thousand barbarian horsemen, and Cavalry Commander Lu An with nine thousand Xia province foot and horse, to relieve Yang Yu;

units.zh: 神武明皇后婁氏，諱昭君，贈司徒內干之女也。
units.en: Empress Ming, née Lou, whose personal name was Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Empress Ming, Lady Lou, taboo name Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 神武婁后
units.en: Empress Lou of Shenwu
units.literal: Empress Lou of Shenwu

units.zh: 及拜渤海王妃，閫闈之事悉決焉。
units.en: When she was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.
units.literal: When he was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.

units.zh: 文襄嗣位，進為太妃。
units.en: When Gao Cheng succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.
units.literal: When Wenxiang succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.

units.zh: 天保初，尊為皇太后，宮曰宣訓。
units.en: At the opening of the Tianbao era, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.

units.zh: 孝昭即位，復為皇太后。
units.en: When Gao Yan succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 濟南即位，尊為太皇太后。
units.en: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 太皇太后密與孝昭及諸大將定策誅之，下令廢立。
units.en: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Gao Yan and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing one ruler and enthroning another.
units.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Xiaozhao and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing and enthroning.

units.zh: 大寧二年春，太后寢疾，衣忽自舉，用巫媼言改姓石氏。
units.en: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.
units.literal: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.

units.zh: 孝昭帝崩，太后又下詔立武成帝。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.

units.zh: 及見神武於城上執役，驚曰：「此真吾夫也。」
units.en: When she saw Gao Huan laboring on the city wall, she started and said, "This is truly my husband."
units.literal: When she saw Shenwu performing labor on the city wall, she was startled and said: "This is truly my husband."

units.zh: 乃使婢通意，又數致私財，使以聘己，父母不得已而許焉。
units.en: She sent a maid to convey her feelings and repeatedly sent private funds so that he might betroth her; her parents, having no choice, consented.
units.literal: She then sent a maid to convey her feelings, and repeatedly sent private funds so that he might betroth her; her parents, having no choice, consented.

units.zh: 弟昭，以功名自達，其餘親屬，未嘗為請爵位。
units.en: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.
units.literal: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.

units.zh: 太后凡孕六男二女，皆感夢：孕文襄則夢一斷龍；
units.en: The empress dowager in all bore six sons and two daughters, each pregnancy attended by a dream: when she conceived Gao Cheng she dreamed of a severed dragon;
units.literal: The empress dowager in all bore six sons and two daughters, each pregnancy attended by a dream: when she conceived Wenxiang she dreamed of a severed dragon;

units.zh: 孕文宣則夢大龍，首尾屬天地，張口動目，勢狀驚人；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Yang she dreamed of a great dragon whose head and tail joined heaven and earth, mouth open and eyes moving, its aspect terrifying;
units.literal: when she conceived Wenxuan she dreamed of a great dragon whose head and tail joined heaven and earth, mouth open and eyes moving, its aspect terrifying;

units.zh: 孕孝昭則夢蠕龍於地；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Yan she dreamed of a writhing dragon upon the ground;
units.literal: when she conceived Xiaozhao she dreamed of a writhing dragon upon the ground;

units.zh: 孕武成則夢龍浴於海；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Zhan she dreamed of a dragon bathing in the sea;
units.literal: when she conceived Wucheng she dreamed of a dragon bathing in the sea;

units.zh: 孕魏二后並夢月入懷；
units.en: when she conceived the two Wei empresses she both dreamed of the moon entering the bosom;
units.literal: when she conceived the two Wei empresses she both dreamed of the moon entering the bosom;

units.zh: 孕襄城、博陵二王夢鼠入衣下。
units.en: when she conceived the Princes of Xiangcheng and Boling she dreamed of rats entering beneath the garments.
units.literal: when she conceived the Princes of Xiangcheng and Boling she dreamed of rats entering beneath the garments.

units.zh: 四月辛丑，崩於北宮，時年六十二。
units.en: On the xinchou day of the fourth month she died at the Northern Palace, aged sixty-two.
units.literal: On the xinchou day of the fourth month she died at the Northern Palace, aged sixty-two.

units.zh: 五月甲申，合葬義平陵。
units.en: On the jiashen day of the fifth month she was interred with Gao Huan at Yiping Tomb.
units.literal: On the jiashen day of the fifth month she was interred with Shenwu at Yiping Tomb.

units.zh: 文宣將受魏禪，后固執不許，帝所以中止。
units.en: When Gao Yang was about to receive the Wei abdication, the empress firmly refused to permit it, and the emperor therefore desisted.
units.literal: When Wenxuan was about to receive the Wei abdication, the empress firmly refused to permit it, and the emperor therefore desisted.

units.zh: 神武嘗將西討出師，後夜孿生一男一女，左右以危急，請追告神武。
units.en: Once, as Gao Huan was about to march west on campaign, the empress gave birth at night to twins, a boy and a girl. Those beside her, finding the situation perilous, asked to send word after him.
units.literal: Once when Shenwu was about to march west on campaign, the empress at night bore twins, a boy and a girl; those beside her, finding the situation perilous, asked to send word after Shenwu.

units.zh: 后弗聽曰：「王出統大兵，何得以我故輕離軍幕。
units.en: The empress would not hear of it. "The king has gone forth to command a great army," she said. "He cannot lightly leave the command tent on my account.
units.literal: The empress would not listen and said: "The king has gone forth to command a great army — how can he lightly leave the command tent on my account.

units.zh: 死生命也，來復何為！」
units.en: Life and death are fate — what use is it if he comes back!"
units.literal: Life and death are fate — what use is it if he comes back!"

units.zh: 沙苑敗後，侯景屢言請精騎二萬，必能取之。
units.en: After the defeat at Shaya, Hou Jing repeatedly asked for twenty thousand picked cavalry, saying he could certainly recover the lost ground.
units.literal: After the defeat at Shaya, Hou Jing repeatedly asked for twenty thousand picked cavalry, saying he could certainly recover it.

units.zh: 神武悅，以告于后。
units.en: Gao Huan was pleased and told the empress.
units.literal: Shenwu was pleased and told the empress.

units.zh: 后曰：「若如其言，豈有還理，得獺失景，亦有何利。」
units.en: The empress said, "If things go as he promises, there would be no reason for him to return. You would gain some paltry conquest and lose Hou Jing; there would be no profit in that."
units.literal: The empress said: "If it comes about as he says, could there be any coming back — gain the otter, lose Jing; what profit is there."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: Thereupon he desisted.
units.literal: Thereupon he desisted.

units.zh: 及茹茹公主至，后避正室處之。
units.en: When the Rouran princess arrived, the empress vacated the main chamber to lodge her.
units.literal: When the Rouran princess arrived, the empress vacated the main chamber to lodge her.

units.zh: 后曰：「國家大計，願不疑也。」
units.en: The empress said, "This is a great plan for the state — do not hesitate."
units.literal: The empress said: "This is a great plan for the state — do not hesitate."

units.zh: 性寬厚，不妒忌，神武姬侍，咸加恩待。
units.en: Her nature was generous and free of jealousy; Gao Huan's concubines and attendants she treated with equal favor.
units.literal: Her nature was generous and she was not jealous; Shenwu's concubines and attendants she all treated with favor.

units.zh: 后高明嚴斷，雅遵儉約，往來外舍，侍從不過十人。
units.en: The empress was lofty in judgment, clear-minded, and stern; she always observed thrift, and when she went out to external residences her attendants never exceeded ten.
units.literal: The empress was lofty, clear, and stern in judgment; she always observed thrift; when going out to external residences, her attendants never exceeded ten.

units.zh: 神武既有澄清之志，傾產以結英豪，密謀秘策，后恒參預。
units.en: Once Gao Huan resolved to restore order, he spent his estate to win over heroes; in secret plots and hidden stratagems Empress Lou always took part.
units.literal: Once Shenwu had the will to restore order, he spent his estate to win over heroes; in secret plots and hidden stratagems the empress always took part.

units.zh: 后未崩，有童謠曰「九龍母死不作孝」。
units.en: Before the empress dowager died, a children's rhyme ran: "Nine dragons — when the mother dies, no mourning."
units.literal: Before the empress dowager died, a children's rhyme said: "Nine dragons — when the mother dies, no mourning."

units.zh: 及后崩，武成不改服，緋袍如故。
units.en: When the empress dowager died, Wucheng did not change his garments and kept his crimson robe as before.
units.literal: When the empress dowager died, Wucheng did not change his garments and kept his crimson robe as before.

units.zh: 論曰：神武肇興齊業，武明追蹤周亂。
units.en: The appraisal says: Shenwu founded Qi's enterprise, but Wuming followed the path of Zhou's disorder.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Shenwu first raised the enterprise of Qi, but Wuming followed the track of Zhou's disorder.

units.zh: 及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。
units.en: When he came to the throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others served jointly as his advisers.
units.literal: When he inherited the great throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others assisted him together.

units.zh: 帝至東閤門，都督成休甯抽刃呵帝。
units.en: At the Eastern Pavilion Gate, the commander Cheng Xiuning drew his sword and shouted at the prince.
units.literal: The Emperor reached the Eastern Pavilion Gate; the Commander Cheng Xiuning drew his blade and shouted at the Emperor.

units.zh: 歸彥旣為領軍，素為兵士所服，悉皆弛仗，休寧歎息而罷。
units.en: Gao Guiyan, now Commander-in-Chief, was a man the troops had long trusted. At his word they lowered their arms, and Xiuning sighed and stood down.
units.literal: Gao Guiyan, having become Commander-in-Chief, was long respected by the soldiers; all laid down their weapons, and Xiuning sighed and desisted.

units.zh: 帝令高歸彥喻之，休甯厲聲大呼不從。
units.en: The prince sent Gao Guiyan to reason with him, but Xiuning roared his refusal.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered Gao Guiyan to explain to him; Xiuning shouted loudly and would not obey.

units.zh: 先是童謠云：「中興寺內白鳧翁，四方側聽聲雍雍，道人聞之夜打鐘。」
units.en: Before this a children's rhyme said, "At Zhongxing Temple, a white duck old man — from the four quarters they listen, the sound harmonious; the Daoist hears it and at night strikes the bell."
units.literal: Before this a children's rhyme said, "At Zhongxing Temple, a white duck old man — from the four quarters they listen, the sound harmonious; the Daoist hears it and at night strikes the bell."

units.zh: 道人，濟南王小名。
units.en: "The Daoist" was the Prince of Ji'nan's childhood name.
units.literal: "The Daoist" was the Prince of Ji'nan's childhood name.

units.zh: 先是，恒留濟南於鄴，除領軍厙狄伏連為幽州刺史，以斛律豐樂為領軍，以分武成之權。
units.en: Before this, the Prince of Ji'nan had always been kept at Ye; Kudi Fulian was made governor of You Province, and Hulu Fengle was made commander of the army — both to divide Gao Zhan's power.
units.literal: Before this, the Prince of Ji'nan had always been kept at Ye; Kudi Fulian was made Governor of You Province, and Hulu Fengle was made Commander of the Army — both to divide Wucheng's power.

units.zh: 昭帝以為濟南應之，乃使平秦王歸彥之鄴，迎濟南赴幷州。
units.en: Gao Yan thought the Prince of Ji'nan corresponded to it; he therefore sent Prince Guiyan of Pingqin to Ye to welcome the Prince of Ji'nan to Bing Province.
units.literal: Emperor Zhao thought the Prince of Ji'nan corresponded to it; he therefore sent Prince Guiyan of Pingqin to Ye to welcome the Prince of Ji'nan to Bing Province.

units.zh: 武成乃奉詔，令數百騎送濟南於晉陽。
units.en: Gao Zhan thereupon obeyed the edict and sent several hundred horsemen to escort the Prince of Ji'nan to Jinyang.
units.literal: Wucheng thereupon obeyed the edict and sent several hundred horsemen to escort the Prince of Ji'nan to Jinyang.

units.zh: 鳧翁，謂雄雞，蓋指武成小字步落稽也。
units.en: "Duck old man" means rooster — it pointed to Gao Zhan's childhood name Buluoqi.
units.literal: "Duck old man" means rooster — it pointed to Wucheng's childhood name Buluoqi.

units.zh: 打鐘，言將被擊也。
units.en: "Strikes the bell" meant he would be beaten.
units.literal: "Strikes the bell" meant he would be beaten.

units.zh: 因逼之，答曰：「濟南世嫡，主上假太后令而奪之。
units.en: Pressed, he answered, "The Prince of Ji'nan is the legitimate heir; the sovereign seized the throne through the Empress Dowager's order.
units.literal: Pressed, he answered, "The Prince of Ji'nan is the legitimate heir; the sovereign seized the throne through the Empress Dowager's order.

units.zh: 旣而太史奏言北城有天子氣。
units.en: Soon afterward the court astrologer memorialized that there was an emperor's aura in the northern city.
units.literal: Soon afterward the court astrologer memorialized that there was an emperor's aura in the northern city.

units.zh: 今集文武，示以此勑，執豐樂，斬歸彥，尊濟南，號令天下，以順討逆，此萬世一時也。」
units.en: Now gather the civil and military officials, display this edict, seize Fengle, behead Guiyan, honor the Prince of Ji'nan, and proclaim to the realm — with righteousness to punish rebellion, this would be a once-in-ten-thousand-generations opportunity."
units.literal: Now gather the civil and military officials, display this edict, seize Fengle, behead Guiyan, honor the Prince of Ji'nan, and proclaim to the realm — with righteousness to punish rebellion, this would be a once-in-ten-thousand-generations opportunity."

units.zh: 初濟南自晉陽之鄴，楊愔宣勑，留從駕五千兵於西中，陰備非常。
units.en: When Prince of Jinan first traveled from Jinyang to Ye, Yang Yin read the edict leaving five thousand troops of the escort in the Western Quarter — a secret guard against surprise.
units.literal: At first, when the Prince of Jinan went from Jinyang to Ye, Yang Yin proclaimed the edict and left five thousand troops of the imperial escort in the Western Quarter, secretly preparing against the unexpected.

units.zh: 十一月乙卯，以右丞相、咸陽王斛律金爲左丞相，以錄尚書事、常山王演爲太傅，以司徒、長廣王湛爲太尉，以司空段韶爲司徒，以平陽王淹爲司空，高陽王湜爲尚書左僕射，河間王孝琬爲司州牧，侍中燕子獻爲右僕射。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, Hulu Jin, Prince of Xianyang and right chief minister, was appointed left chief minister; Prince Yan of Changshan, recorder of the Masters of Writing, became grand tutor; Prince Zhan of Changguang, minister over the masses, became grand commandant; Duan Shao, minister of works, became minister over the masses; Prince Yan of Pingyang became minister of works; Prince Shi of Gaoyang became left vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Xiaowan of Hejian became governor of Sizhou; and Yanzi Xian, palace attendant, became right vice-director.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, the right chief minister, Prince of Xianyang Hulu Jin, was made left chief minister; Prince Yan of Changshan, recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing, was made grand tutor; Prince Zhan of Changguang, minister over the masses, was made grand commandant; Duan Shao, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Prince Yan of Pingyang was made minister of works; Prince Shi of Gaoyang was made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was made governor of Sizhou; and Yanzi Xian, attendant at the palace, was made right vice-director.

units.zh: 中軍大都督兼領軍大將軍楊津入宿殿中，掃灑宮庭，封閉府庫，出迎魏主於北邙，流涕謝罪，帝慰勞之。
units.en: Grand Commander of the Central Army and concurrent Defender-General Yang Jin lodged in the palace, swept the courts, sealed the treasuries, went out to welcome the Wei emperor at Northern Mang, wept, and apologized; the emperor comforted him.
units.literal: The Grand Commander of the Central Army and concurrent Defender-General Yang Jin entered to lodge in the palace hall, swept the palace courts, sealed the treasuries and storehouses, went out to welcome the Wei ruler at Northern Mang, wept and apologized for his fault; the Emperor comforted and encouraged him.
